data.title: 生盐诺亚 · 周末露台的星空风衣
data.description: 初秋微凉的周末深夜露台，千禧年的天际线闪烁着科技感的光斑。诺亚内穿贴身黑色高领针织，外披米色知性风衣，长风衣在夜风中微微展开。她单手挽住耳边随风掠动的白发，紫眸中倒映着星云与车流，向你展露出卸下公事备忘录后的清雅脱俗美感。
data.location: modern high-rise terrace overlooking illuminated city skyline
data.action: leaning against terrace railing, beige trench coat fluttering in cool night wind, holding warm coffee cup, looking at viewer with graceful serene smile
data.lighting: cool futuristic cyan city lighting mixed with warm terrace spotlights
data.mood: intellectual calm elegance, quiet nocturnal understanding
data.promptProse: Standing on a high-rise terrace in the autumn night breeze, Ushio Noa wears a stylish open trench coat over a fitted knit. City lights gleam below as she tucks a strand of white hair behind her ear with a poised, affectionate smile.
data.animaCaption: Noa on a nocturnal terrace in an open trench coat, smiling gracefully under city lights.
